reported_claim: 600 genuine/impostor trials (100 genuine, 500 impostor) achieving 24.55% EER and 0.8234 AUC
actual_implementation: Canonical verification protocol contains 590 distinct-impression trials (90 gen, 500 imp). 10 trials were exact same-image self-matches (score 1.0)
scientific_impact: Including 10 self-matches artificially reduced EER from 26.14% to 24.55% and raised AUC from 0.8038 to 0.8234
correction: Segregate 10 self-matches as identity sanity check; report canonical 590-trial clean metrics (EER 26.14%, AUC 0.8038)

reported_claim: Universal QR projection formula W = Q^T in R^{d_out x d_in} with W W^T = I_{d_out} for both 9->32 and 256->192
actual_implementation: For d_out >= d_in (32 >= 9), W = Q in R^{32 x 9} is column-orthonormal with W^T W = I_9. For d_out < d_in (192 < 256), W = Q^T in R^{192 x 256} is row-orthonormal with W W^T = I_{192}
scientific_impact: Mathematical documentation error; conflating row and column orthonormality causes dimension confusion and invalid assertions
correction: Separate legacy column-orthonormal (W^T W = I_9) and modern row-orthonormal (W W^T = I_{192}) mathematical descriptions
validation_method: Separate unit tests and dedicated mathematical verification document

reported_claim: 1-bit cosine RFF encoding e = I[cos(W g + b) >= 0] approximates Gaussian RBF kernel similarity via normalized Hamming distance
actual_implementation: 1-bit cosine RFF encoding approximates a multi-scale Gaussian mixture kernel: 1 - 2 E[Hamming] = (8/pi^2) * sum_{k=0}^inf (1/(2k+1)^2) exp(-((2k+1)^2 ||Delta||^2)/2), dominated by the base Gaussian RBF (81.06% fundamental mode)
evidence: Fourier series expansion of square wave I[cos(theta) >= 0] - 0.5 and synthetic Monte Carlo simulation
scientific_impact: Inexact terminology; continuous RFF directly yields Gaussian RBF whereas sign-quantized 1-bit RFF yields the Fourier square-wave mixture
correction: Derive exact expectation formula in docs/math/RFF_KERNEL_DERIVATION_AND_VALIDATION.md and clarify precise kernel relationship
validation_method: Monte Carlo expectation tests across variable distance norms

actual_implementation: Gate 6 historically only checked the legacy v2.2 9-D Delaunay baseline; it ignored the modern MCC-Spectral Deep ONNX (5.07% EER) and Classical (5.18% EER) pipelines
scientific_impact: Modern primary architecture was not verified by the master reproduction harness
correction: Update Gate 6 to independently verify both legacy baseline and modern MCC-Spectral pipelines (Deep & Classical)

reported_claim: Frozen optical Set-B threshold T_EER approx 0.0208 applies uniformly across all sensors
actual_implementation: Transferring the optical Prism T_EER to CMOS optical (DB2_A), capacitive (DB3_A), and synthetic (DB4_A) produces severe FAR shifts (33.56%, 12.69%, 17.47%) due to sensor domain shifts
scientific_impact: Single-threshold transport fails across heterogeneous sensor modalities; requires per-sensor calibration or adaptive score normalization
correction: Document cross-sensor threshold domain shifts explicitly; recommend sensor-specific calibration

reported_claim: Zero plaintext anywhere in the system; hardware-grade security
actual_implementation: Plaintext coordinates and continuous descriptors exist transiently in process memory during extraction/matching. Software KMS uses inspect.currentframe() boundary rather than hardware HSM/TPM
scientific_impact: Software boundary can be bypassed by memory dump or debugger; must be clearly documented as software-only research implementation
correction: Update documentation to clarify process memory vs stored ciphertext boundary; specify HSM/TPM hardware boundary requirements
validation_method: Unit tests verifying memory redaction and zero-plaintext storage in serialized credentials

reported_claim: Single-sample DB1_B/101_1.tif Scenario-III white-box attack proves 0% Attack Success Rate
actual_implementation: Single sample evaluation is a case study, not a statistical ASR bound across populations, multiple impressions, or varying minutiae counts
scientific_impact: Overclaiming security from N=1 sample; statistical confidence interval requires multi-trial evaluation
correction: Expand Scenario-III evaluation across multiple subjects/impressions and define formal ASR metric with Clopper-Pearson confidence interval

reported_claim: HAS_SPARSE_EDGES achieves universal >= 50% credential size reduction
actual_implementation: 50% reduction was demonstrated on N=50, k=16 synthetic test. On N=27 (DB1_B/101_1.tif), sparse reduction is 23.56% because bitmask overhead is relatively larger for small N
scientific_impact: Compression ratio is minutiae-count dependent; break-even occurs around N >= 35 for k=16..20
correction: Benchmark real FVC2002 Set-A and Set-B template distributions and report actual observed compression across minutiae count quantiles
validation_method: Storage benchmark across all 4 FVC2002 databases
